ValidationRule.description: New Economic Margin field is required if Retained field has a value of "Yes"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
OR(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Retention_RM",
RecordType.Name = "CLAS – Data Management"),
ISBLANK(New_Economic_Margin__c ),
ISPICKVAL(Retained__c,"Yes")
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: New Economic Margin field is required if Retained field has a value of Yes
